Params: {3: "The fire is out, but Jorge's frame bears severe burns across a wide area. Weakened, he is unable to so much as form a response."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Leia', 3: "You're Amazigh... Why did you steal the Ytterbium-174, Ascendant? What are you after?!", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Amazigh', 3: '...Do you really think asking me a question obliges me to answer? Know your place, Construct.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Leia and Sylph have been preparing to strike since the moment Amazigh appeared, even though neither can figure out how she set Jorge ablaze from that distance.'}
{3: 'But now that the Ascendant has shown her hand, and that they cannot get any answer out of her, they have to strike immediately to keep her from pulling that trick again.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Amazigh', 3: "I haven't given you permission to engage me directly.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'Sylph lunges, ready to drive her dagger through the Ascendant, but she barely clears a few steps before Corrupted come bursting through the gaps in the wall of fire, blocking her path.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Leia', 3: 'Fall back, Sylph! There are more Corrupted!', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Leia also stops. More Corrupted pour out of the wall of fire, even after she has put down a whole wave of them. And yet...'}
{2: 'Leia', 3: "Why are there so many? If she wanted to use the Corrupted to hunt down Kronos, she wouldn't need to ambush her on top of that...", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Amazigh', 3: "Pursuing her was just for fun. When even a small fry like you can sniff out the irregularities on this route, it's only a matter of time before others do too.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Amazigh', 3: 'From that moment on, there was no point keeping this route under wraps.', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Leia', 3: 'Then why are you still here attacking us...?', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Sylph', 3: 'Jorge... her only attack this entire time was aimed at Jorge.', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Amazigh', 3: "Correct. I couldn't care less how much of my plan you've pieced together, or what you intend to do to stop me. But traitors? Those I do not tolerate.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Amazigh', 3: "I won't tolerate someone who spilled my plans to you and led you straight here out of sheer self-interest.", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Leia', 3: 'Traitor?! Mr. Jorge was threatened by you from the very start!', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Amazigh', 3: 'He defied my will. That alone is more than enough to earn him that title.', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Leia', 3: '说话装模作样的，你以为你是什么大王吗!', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 3: 'The moment the words leave her lips, every Corrupted lining the fire wall ignites in unison. Shrieking, they hurl themselves toward Leia and the others.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Amazigh', 3: "Time's up. Traitors and those who aid them... none of you will leave here alive.", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Leia', 3: 'Not if I have anything to say about it!', 4: '1'}

{1: '1', 3: 'Leia and Sylph split off to engage on separate fronts. The fire-wreathed monsters keep coming in waves like soldiers who have thrown away their lives, closing in on the dwindling ground the four of them stand on.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Leia', 3: 'Kronos, get back! I need room to cover you!', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Leia and Sylph hold the left and right flanks, but the Corrupted keep pouring out of the flames. The fire walls look less like barriers now and more like portals.'}
{3: 'In the distance, two freighters let out a long, low blast of their horns as they set out to sea.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Leia', 3: 'Sylph, when Amazigh said "time\'s up" just now, did she mean...?', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Sylph', 3: "The ships weren't done loading. That was why she had time to stand around talking to us!", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Amazigh', 3: "As I said, it doesn't matter that you figured it out. I'll get what I want either way, and you'll die here for your trouble—", 4: '1'}

{3: 'A thunderous cannon blast tears across the wasteland. Everyone turns toward the sound and watches as the two freighters in the shallows take direct hits to their hulls before erupting in a burst of flames.'}
{3: "Issarius' voice comes through clearly over a distant loudspeaker, unquestionably calm."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Issarius', 3: "I know you're in the middle of a fight, so I'll keep it brief.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Issarius', 3: 'Ten minutes. Keep the Ascendant busy until I get there with backup.', 4: '1'}
{3: "The broadcast cuts out. Two more shells strike the freighters' engine rooms with pinpoint accuracy, destroying the propulsion systems and pinning the vessels at the harbor."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Amazigh', 3: 'How unexpected... I had communications in this area completely locked down, so how did that man manage to call for reinforcements?', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Amazigh', 3: "No... that's not even the right question. He shouldn't have known about those ships or what was happening here in the first place.", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Leia', 3: 'Maybe me flying up here gave him some inspiration... and it still does!', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 3: "The moment Amazigh's attention shifts to the freighters, Leia seizes her and vaults off an incoming Corrupted, lunging straight at Amazigh."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Amazigh', 3: 'Who taught you that little dirty trick, Construct?', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Leia', 3: 'Stop calling me Construct! My name is Leia! Leia of the Egret squad!', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Amazigh', 3: 'Leia... The others did keep calling you that name just now.', 4: '1'}
{3: "At the sound of Leia's name, the indifference on Amazigh's face cracks just barely. A flicker of scrutiny crosses her eyes, as though she has spotted something interesting."}
{2: 'Amazigh', 3: "I see. I felt it when we crossed blades, too... You're Arius' puppet, aren't you?", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Leia', 3: '...What do you mean by that? Do you know me?', 4: '1'}
{3: "With a casual flick of her hand, Amazigh conjures a wall of fire between them, cutting Leia's advance dead in its tracks."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Amazigh', 3: 'My business here is concluded. I have no intention of wasting my time on a pointless brawl with the likes of you.', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Leia', 3: "Pretty words! Concluded? Your plan failed and you're running away, plain and simple! Aren't you, Amazigh?!", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Amazigh', 3: "Goading me won't get you anywhere... Besides, do you really think I failed?", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Amazigh', 3: "The better question is what you've planned for me. Humans are creatures who keep making mistakes, and behind each mistake may just be another Jorge.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Amazigh', 3: 'How many Jorges do you think I had working for me before you exposed the routes and stopped those two ships? And what do you suppose I had them do?', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Leia', 3: "I don't know, and I don't care! No matter how many people there are, no matter what you're planning, I will stop you, Amazigh!", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Amazigh', 3: "Stop me...? Save it for when you've survived this, puppet.", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Right then, the swarm of Corrupted that has been surrounding Sylph and Kronos turns around as one, surging forward to encircle Leia and cut off her pursuit.'}
{3: "On the other side of the flames, Amazigh's tall silhouette slowly fades into the blaze. By the time Leia breaks through the blockade and hurls herself through the fire, heedless of the danger—"}
{3: '—Amazigh is already gone. All that remains is the wildfire spreading in every direction and swarms of Corrupted scattered everywhere.'}
{3: 'The Ascendant is gone, but the destruction she wove with her own hands still blankets every corner of the desolate ruins.'}
